name: B10-0135/2026 (ECR) – World Cancer Day
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on World Cancer Day
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is setting out its position on cancer care and calling on the European Commission and member states to act. It asks for more money and coordination for Europe's cancer plan, a dedicated EU cancer fund, better access to screening and treatment, and extra support for children with cancer and their families. It also wants cancer survivors to be treated fairly when buying insurance or credit.

- **What changes:** Nothing yet. These are requests and opinions, not new rules.
- **Who it affects:** Cancer patients, survivors, families, health workers and researchers across the EU.
- **What happens next:** The Parliament sends its requests to the Commission and member states, which decide whether to act.
